snippet.title: Seferia Matrix Official Trailer 3
snippet.description:
Seferia Matrix is a Dice Roguelike desckbuilder.
Build your own style of mages with hundreds of items and choices.
The only limit is your imagination, and you can make your own luck!

Play demo and wishlist now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4515500/Seferia_Matrix/
